data.name: SearchPlaceholder
data.comment: Greyed prompt in the empty search box above the task list.

data.name: AboutCaption
data.comment: Title bar of the about box, opened from Help.

data.name: AboutHeading
data.comment: Large heading at the top of the about box. {0} is the version, written as a release tag such as v1.2.3.

data.name: AboutTagline
data.value: A keyboard-driven Todoist client for Windows.
data.comment: One-line description under the about box's heading.

data.name: AboutLicences
data.comment: Line in the about box. {0} is a link whose text is the file name THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, which isn't translated.

data.name: AboutShowDiagnostics
data.comment: Button in the about box that reveals the folders Termyn uses. Paired with AboutHideDiagnostics.

data.name: AboutHideDiagnostics
data.comment: The same button once the folders are showing, which collapses them again.

data.name: AboutFolderInstalled
data.comment: Label in the about box's diagnostics, above a link to the folder Termyn runs from.

data.name: AboutFolderSettings
data.comment: Label in the about box's diagnostics, above a link to the folder holding the settings file and the encrypted Todoist token.

data.name: AboutFolderCache
data.comment: Label in the about box's diagnostics, above a link to the folder holding the local copy of the account.

data.name: AboutFolderLog
data.comment: Label in the about box's diagnostics, above a link to the folder of log files.

data.name: AboutHomepageFailed
data.comment: Status bar message when clicking the GitHub link in the about box fails.

data.name: AboutNoticesMissing
data.comment: Status bar message when the THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt link in the about box finds no file.

data.name: AboutFolderMissing
data.comment: Status bar message when a folder linked from the about box's diagnostics doesn't exist, usually because nothing has been written to it yet.
